ctaHeading: Ready to Transform Your Brunswick Backyard?
aboutText: Based in Brunswick, Annett Landscapes is a leading landscape design and construction team committed to transforming outdoor spaces across Melbourne's inner north. With years of experience, we specialise in creating beautiful, functional environments, from intimate garden retreats to complete outdoor living transformations. Our team brings creativity, care, and expert craftsmanship to every project, handling everything from initial concept through to final construction.
servicesSubheading: Design, build and transform your outdoor space
servicesText: At Annett Landscapes, we offer a complete range of landscape design and construction services tailored to your vision. From concept planning and garden design to hard and soft landscaping, we transform Brunswick backyards into stunning outdoor spaces where beauty meets relaxation.

services.title: Landscape Design
services.desc: Our creative design team works with you from initial concept to detailed plans, ensuring your outdoor space reflects your vision and lifestyle.

services.title: Landscape Construction
services.desc: From retaining walls to paving and decking, our skilled builders bring your landscape design to life with precision and quality craftsmanship.

services.title: Garden Makeovers
services.desc: We transform tired, outdated gardens into fresh, modern outdoor spaces with new planting, layout redesign, and feature elements tailored to you.

services.title: Outdoor Living Spaces
services.desc: Create the perfect entertaining area with custom-built outdoor kitchens, fire pits, seating, and lighting designed for the Melbourne climate.

services.title: Retaining Walls
services.desc: Engineered retaining walls built to last, adding structure, planting space, and visual interest to sloped or uneven Brunswick properties.

services.title: Planting & Soft Landscaping
services.desc: Expert plant selection and garden bed creation using native and ornamental species suited to Brunswick's soil and climate conditions.
